options.description: Do not post the findings to the PR (the default; accepted for parity with the /ultrareview and /code-review ultra flags)

options.name: --post
options.description: Post the finished review's findings to the PR as you (PR targets only; one plain comment, not a review)

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Maximum minutes to wait for the review to finish (default: 45)
